checks.cmd: ! git grep -nE '= test_[a-z_]+\.[A-Z][A-Za-z]+\.[a-z_]+' -- tests && ! git grep -n '\.plane-runtime' -- 'tests/test_*.py' ':(exclude)tests/test_plane_json_constants.py' && test "$(LC_ALL=C git grep -hE 'assert(Not)?In\("[^"]{40,}' -- 'tests/*.py' | wc -l)" -le 345 && python3 -B -c 'import ast,subprocess,sys;fs=subprocess.run(["git","ls-files","tests/*.py"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines();imp=lambda n:isinstance(n,ast.Import) and any(a.name.startswith("tests.test_") for a in n.names);frm=lambda n:isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom) and ((n.module or "").split(".")[-1].startswith("test_") or ((n.module=="tests" and n.level==0) or (n.module is None and n.level==1)) and any(a.name.startswith("test_") for a in n.names));hits=[f"{f}:{n.lineno}" for f in fs for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(open(f).read(),f)) if imp(n) or frm(n)];[print(h) for h in hits];sys.exit(1 if hits else 0)  # E4: no test module imports another (import tests.test_x, from tests import test_x, from . import test_x)' && ! git grep -nF '__file__).resolve().parent' -- 'tests/*.py' ':(exclude)tests/helpers.py' && ! git grep -nw GIT_AUTHOR_NAME -- 'tests/*.py' ':(exclude)tests/helpers.py'
! git grep -n -e merge-tree -e patch-id -e remerge-diff -- ccp ':(exclude)ccp/gitmerge.py'
